## Description

A twisted crescent-shaped green alga (8–14 × 2–3 µm, 40–60 µm³), the alga of the OECD 201 standard
toxicity test. It grows fast, is very sensitive to pollutants and divides into 4 autospores.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 12 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

A 5 µm-wide silhouette (a 2.5 µm one is not stable as a soft body) with its thickness reduced to
match the measured volume (~50 µm³); 4 autospores per cycle.

## Literature

- OECD (2011) Test No. 201, annex 2: 1.5–1.7/day in OECD medium at ~70 µE m⁻² s⁻¹ and 21 °C
  (*P. subcapitata* ATCC 22662).

## Not implemented yet

- No toxicity test on eukaryotes yet (reagents target only bacteria; roadmap E).
- The twisted crescent is approximated.

## Unique and shared mechanics

Shares autospores with *Chlorella* and *Desmodesmus*.
